metadata.name: 真实OSM建筑远景LOD
metadata.coverage: OSM-mapped buildings within Shinan, Shibei, Licang, Laoshan, Chengyang, Huangdao, Jimo and Jiaozhou. Missing buildings are not invented. This is an observed-footprint proxy, not a full urban land-use survey.
metadata.lodPolicy: All source buildings retained one-to-one, represented by their actual minimum rotated enclosing rectangle. Original detailed footprints, names and height-source tags remain in chunks. Rectangle corners may overfill concave roofs; positions/dimensions are rounded to 0.1m and rotation to 1e-5rad.
metadata.rotationConvention: rotationY in radians: local width axis maps to world (cos(angle), -sin(angle)) in XZ, matching Babylon rotation.y. Width is the longest rectangle edge.
metadata.urbanCellNote: 250m cells contain only intersections of actual source building footprints. Sum area is not a union and overlapping parts can double-count. Observed bounds are footprint envelopes within each cell, never whole administrative polygons. Use area/count as a coverage proxy; do not label cells as surveyed urban landcover.
